reviewMethod: Planned screening checklist based on E0-E3 metadata; not a systematic review, live source check, risk-of-bias assessment or extracted outcome database.
gatePrinciple: All cross-study quantitative effect-separation claims remain blocked until appropriate independent source review and endpoint extraction; do not infer unreported data from NOT_EXTRACTED status.

records.nextExtraction: Verify full-method comparability of neural structural and hallucinogenic-like rodent endpoints.
records.mostImportantConfound: Align exposure, observation time and sensitivity of each animal readout.
records.prohibitedInference: Behavioral proxies cannot establish absent hallucinations or clinical benefit.

records.nextExtraction: Extract product-specific human seizure endpoints separately from intoxication and THC-related outcomes.
records.mostImportantConfound: Separate CBD's labeled indication from any molecule-to-molecule THC comparison.
records.prohibitedInference: Approval of CBD is not evidence that THC's effects were selectively preserved.

records.nextExtraction: Extract separately reported rodent analgesia, breathing and reinforcing-behavior endpoints.
records.mostImportantConfound: Review exposure differences, receptor engagement and adverse-endpoint sensitivity.
records.prohibitedInference: No opioid safety, non-addiction or clinical analgesia inference in humans.

records.nextExtraction: Extract cell-specific remodeling and head-twitch readouts with their units and time windows.
records.mostImportantConfound: Separate cortical circuit manipulation effects from subjective human hallucinatory experience.
records.prohibitedInference: Mouse head twitch is not a direct hallucination or antidepressant-outcome measure.

records.nextExtraction: Document analogue selectivity and specific preclinical behavioral endpoints independently.
records.mostImportantConfound: Check receptor selectivity, exposure and off-target effects before connecting endpoints.
records.prohibitedInference: Different DMT-family compounds and rodent behavior cannot prove non-hallucinogenic human treatment.

records.nextExtraction: Extract rodent fear-extinction, plasticity and adverse physiological readouts separately.
records.mostImportantConfound: Audit exposure, dose-response interpretation and physiological confounders from published methods.
records.prohibitedInference: Preclinical plasticity is not established PTSD efficacy or proven human safety.

records.nextExtraction: Extract acute human subjective and physiological effects and their uncertainty, not therapy outcomes.
records.mostImportantConfound: Separate healthy-volunteer crossover effects from clinical PTSD response or long-term harm.
records.prohibitedInference: Longer or stronger intoxication does not rank therapeutic benefit.

records.nextExtraction: Extract Phase 1 acute dissociation and tolerability outcomes without inventing depression response.
records.mostImportantConfound: Separate healthy-volunteer safety from relevant patient efficacy and follow-up.
records.prohibitedInference: Human Phase 1 tolerability cannot establish antidepressant efficacy.

records.nextExtraction: Extract measured MDMA/MDA exposures and acute outcomes under CYP2D6 variation.
records.mostImportantConfound: Check parent/metabolite attribution and confounding before inferring causal mediation.
records.prohibitedInference: Changing MDA formation has no established therapeutic benefit or demonstrated clinical safety.

records.nextExtraction: Capture indication-specific product-label efficacy and adverse effects independently.
records.mostImportantConfound: Distinguish observed co-occurrence of dissociation from causal necessity for antidepressant response.
records.prohibitedInference: Approved esketamine is not proof a dissociation-free analogue retains efficacy.
